name: 19095 · Wyncote, PA
findings: ZIP 19095 (Wyncote) has 48 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19095 (Wyncote) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
